---
title: "Gene dementia function"
---


```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(gt, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

### DMPs 

```{r}
# Derive the genome-wide significant (p < 1e-8) CpG set from the annotated table
source(here("custom_func/select_sig_cg.R"))

dmp <-
  read_rds(here("data/upon_request/annotated_asso_wide.rds")) |>
  select_sig_cg(8)

glimpse(dmp)
```

### Dementia-related functions

```{r}
dementia_related_relevance <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/dementia_relevance_for_top_genes.rds"))

glimpse(dementia_related_relevance)
```

## Expand gene annotation

```{r}

gene_dmp <- 
  dmp |> 
  select(cg, chr, pos, great_anno, contains("p_value")) |>
  separate_longer_delim(great_anno, delim = stringr::regex(" |, ", ignore_case = TRUE)) |> 
  # Remove the rows like (+83228) or (-299) or (0)
  filter(!str_detect(great_anno, "\\(\\+\\d+|\\-\\d+|\\(0\\)")) 

glimpse(gene_dmp)
```

## Join dementia-related functions

```{r}

gene_dmp_dementia_relevance <- 
  gene_dmp |> 
  left_join(dementia_related_relevance, by = c("great_anno" = "gene_symbol"))
  

glimpse(gene_dmp_dementia_relevance)
```


## Make a table

```{r}

gene_dmp_dementia_relevance_gt_table <- 
  gene_dmp_dementia_relevance |>
  # filter(closeness_level <= 2) |>
  select(cg, great_anno, dementia_relevance) |>
  filter(!is.na(dementia_relevance)) |>
  gt() |>
  # Column labels
  cols_label(
    cg = "DMP",
    great_anno = "Gene",
    dementia_relevance = "Dementia relevance"
  ) |>
  # Column width
  cols_width(
    cg ~ px(100),
    great_anno ~ px(100),
    dementia_relevance ~ px(2000)
  ) |>
  # Bold column labels
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  # Add a footnote for the DMPs
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = html("Differentially methylated probes passing the threshold of 1.0 x 10<sup>-8</sup>."),
    locations = cells_column_labels(cg)
  ) 

gene_dmp_dementia_relevance_gt_table
```


## Save the result

```{r}

fs::dir_create("output")
# The data 
write_rds(gene_dmp_dementia_relevance, "output/gene_dmp_dementia_relevance.rds")

# The table
write_rds(gene_dmp_dementia_relevance_gt_table, "output/gene_dmp_dementia_relevance_gt_table.rds")
```
